notes: S2 (§14.5 steps (4) and (5)), expectation corrected by S2-FIX1 T2 (decision 2026-11-15 #18; §4.4 step 2): the note's first entry is by a declared key and fails the equation; its second entry names a key that nothing declares. Key resolution (step (4)) covers every entry and every resolved entry is verified, and an invalid outcome beats an unverifiable one: a known-key signature that fails the equation makes the record invalid E_SIG_INVALID, and an entry by an undeclared key cannot lower it to unverifiable E_KEY_UNKNOWN. Every entry still reports its state (invalid, unverified).
